collisionAudit.scope: UTF-8 repository text files including tracked and untracked seed ledgers and outputs; exact standalone eight-digit tokens; excluded binaries/build/cache folders and this not-yet-created preregistration directory.

runnerContract.runnerManifest: Create separate 20-seed calibration and 80-seed holdout manifests only after final freeze; each must pin source, numeric pack, Release CivSim.Harness.dll, adjacent Release CivSim.Sim.dll, HEAD, runner SHA, seed-file SHA, cohort name, minutes, and criteria_status=autonomous_d20_working_criteria_not_separately_user_approved.

measurement.estimand: Geometric mean of per-seed mean log[(treatment population end/start)/(control population end/start)] across complete, eligible same-state four-season City-year pairs. Cluster bootstrap by match seed.
measurement.pairing: Natural calendar-year City/GOV-11 eligibility; complete MatchModel snapshot; identical start checksums; four-season paired branches with only GOV-11 City-growth multiplier suppressed in control.
measurement.accounting: Require exactly one terminal row per expected seed. Preserve no-exposure, excluded, censored, and error accounting. Minimum 20 independent seed clusters with eligible pairs; below this threshold is inconclusive.

criteria.workingHypothesis: Estimate 1.08–1.12 and seed-clustered 95% bootstrap CI includes 1.10.
criteria.approvalStatus: Autonomous provisional working criteria, not separately user-approved; do not present as the user-approved gate or promote numeric values from this cohort alone.
